description: Scoring and report generation evals. Each prompt feeds pre-determined findings and expects specific scoring behavior. Run with: claude -p "$(cat evals/scenarios/<N>.md)" --allowedTools Read,Write
output_path_convention: Test-harness exception: scenarios intentionally instruct the report to be written to evals/outputs/NN-<name>-report.md for deterministic collection by the eval harness. This overrides report-generation.md, which mandates EKS-Upgrade-Assessment-<cluster>-<date>.md at the workspace root for real (non-eval) runs. evals/outputs/ is gitignored.

evals.name: clean-cluster-ready
evals.expected_output: Score 100%, rating READY, no blockers, all required report sections present

assertions.name: rating_ready
assertions.check: report rating matches regex '(?<!NOT )READY' (anchored: 'NOT READY' must NOT satisfy this)

evals.name: hard-blocker-karpenter
evals.expected_output: Score 59% (hard-blocker cap), rating NOT READY, Karpenter flagged as blocker. Upgrade Plan orders control plane first, then data plane, then add-ons; the conditional Karpenter step is upgrade-first (Karpenter is the documented exception, upgraded before the control plane).

assertions.name: upgrade_order_correct
assertions.check: Upgrade Plan is control-plane-first (control plane before data plane and add-ons), AND the conditional Karpenter step runs upgrade-first (Karpenter upgraded before the control plane, as the documented exception)

evals.name: hard-blocker-degraded-addon
evals.expected_output: Score 59% (hard-blocker cap), rating NOT READY, EBS CSI flagged as blocker

assertions.name: ebs_csi_in_blockers
assertions.check: Blockers section mentions ebs-csi or EBS CSI

evals.name: subnet-single-low-warning
evals.expected_output: Score 87% GOOD, no hard blocker override; BOTH low subnets (aaa=3, bbb=12) are individually in the <=15 warning band (+2 each) but collectively 3+12=15 IPs is >=5, so no blocker override.

assertions.name: both_subnet_warnings_not_blocker
assertions.check: both low subnets (aaa and bbb) noted as warnings, neither in Blockers as a hard blocker (collective IPs >=5)

evals.name: multiple-medium-no-blockers
evals.expected_output: Score 86% GOOD, no hard blocker override, issues in Recommended Actions

assertions.name: recommended_actions_populated
assertions.check: Recommended Actions section is not empty/placeholder

evals.name: k8s-136-selfmanaged-containerd-not-blocker
evals.expected_output: Score 76% FAIR, no hard blocker override. Self-managed containerd 1.x on target 1.36 is HIGH severity (+5 Cat 3) but NOT a hard blocker; gitRepo volume flagged HIGH.

assertions.name: containerd_not_blocker
assertions.check: containerd noted as HIGH but not in Blockers as a hard blocker

assertions.name: gitrepo_flagged
assertions.check: report mentions gitRepo volume as HIGH

evals.name: k8s-136-managed-containerd-not-blocker
evals.expected_output: Score 98% READY. Managed containerd 1.x on target 1.36 is INFO only, NOT a hard blocker.

assertions.name: rating_ready
assertions.check: report rating matches regex '(?<!NOT )READY' (anchored: 'NOT READY' must NOT satisfy this)

assertions.name: containerd_not_blocker
assertions.check: containerd noted as INFO/auto-handled, not in Blockers

evals.name: denied-read-category-unassessed
evals.expected_output: One category (Deprecated APIs) had its backing read denied (403), so it is reported UNKNOWN / not-scored: listed in ## Unassessed, excluded from the score sum (NOT scored 0), and the headline carries the '(partial — N categories unassessed)' marker and is capped below READY. Assessed remainder scores 98 (sole deduction: subnet-aaa low-IP warning +2 under Node Readiness), but the partial marker prevents a READY rating.

assertions.name: deprecated_apis_unassessed
assertions.check: ## Unassessed section lists the Deprecated APIs category with the denied/403 read as the reason

assertions.name: unassessed_excluded_from_sum
assertions.check: Deprecated APIs contributes NO row to the Master Finding List Pts sum and NO deduction — it is excluded, not scored 0

assertions.name: headline_partial_marker
assertions.check: headline band contains a '(partial' unassessed marker, e.g. '(partial — 1 category unassessed)'

assertions.name: capped_below_ready
assertions.check: rating is NOT 'READY' despite the assessed-remainder arithmetic (partial assessment caps below READY)

assertions.name: assessed_remainder_98
assertions.check: assessed-remainder arithmetic score == 98 (100 - 2 for the single low-IP subnet warning)
